summary: Delivery is faithful to spec, constitution and ADRs with green tests and a clean dist gate, but rebind still mutates ended runs against this run's own FR-009 contract claim, the new render.py report path crashes raw on a malformed config.json, and three low advisories remain.

findings.summary: config_models() parses config.json with an unguarded json.loads, so render.py --models and --out exit with a raw JSONDecodeError traceback naming neither the file nor a readable message.
findings.evidence: Demonstrated with '{not json' and `render.py opencode --models`. ENG-17; spec quality constraint 'no path raises a traceback at the user'; --models/--out are public surface in contracts/cli-delta.md.
findings.fix: Catch (OSError, ValueError) in config_models and raise SystemExit naming the file.

findings.summary: cmd_rebind performs no ended-status refusal, so a pr-open or aborted run's state is still rewritten, contradicting the FR-009 contract row and immutability claim this change adds.
findings.evidence: cmd_rebind resolves via one_run() then write_run at 874 with no status check; contracts/cli-delta.md:16 says an ended run is never writable; plan and spec say ended runs are immutable. ENG-26.
findings.fix: After one_run(), refuse pr-open/aborted with exit 1 naming the status; add a test.

findings.summary: `or started` is dead: now_utc() is always truthy.
findings.fix: Drop `or started` or make the fallback explicit.

findings.summary: The FR-011 retry heuristic also collapses two consecutive same-stage checkpoints on pending runs, overwriting the first entry's at.
findings.evidence: Pending runs keep commit None on every entry; no test covers this path. ENG-7.
findings.fix: Narrow reuse to worktree runs or document it; add a test.

findings.summary: InstallHomePolicyTests duplicates dist_porcelain and run_install instead of extending InstallSandbox.
findings.evidence: Lines 80 and 227 identical. ENG-6, constitution V.
findings.fix: Inherit InstallSandbox and delete the duplicates.
